title: Master SOP: change of salary bank account (IBAN), Lumina Retail NV, BE

steps.value: only via the MyPayslip self-service portal
steps.statement: Employees request the change only through the MyPayslip self-service portal; emailed requests are not accepted.

steps.value: IBAN check digits + account holder name must match
steps.statement: Validate the IBAN check digits and make sure the account holder name matches the employee.

steps.value: call back on the phone number on file
steps.statement: Verify the employee's identity by calling back on the phone number already on file (fraud control).

steps.value: released only after a second consultant approves (four-eyes)
steps.statement: Enter the new IBAN in SAP; it is released only after a second consultant approves it (four-eyes).
Changes received by the 15th apply to that month's payroll; later changes apply from the next month.

steps.value: confirm with last 4 IBAN digits + start month
steps.statement: Confirm to the employee with the last 4 digits of the new IBAN and the month it applies from.

steps.value: store in the personnel file for 5 years
steps.statement: Keep the request and the checks in the personnel file for 5 years.
